[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Durable operation and result contracts[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]durable-operation-contracts[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]durable-operation-contracts: inventory and classify every current [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]_submit_tracked_proc and _submit_proc call site, define versioned [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]mode-0600 request sidecars and typed result envelopes, add focused [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]domain-command entry points for durable patch, agent, bead, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]notification, plugin, workspace, and run operations, and extend the proc[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]submission adapter so callers provide argv, stable fingerprints, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]namespaced concurrency keys, and result paths without accepting or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]serializing Python callables.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]migrate-patch-and-agent-producers: move ACE [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]patch/status/rebase/sync/rewind/mail and agent launch, approve, revert, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cleanup, wait, rename, and tribe-assignment operations onto the durable [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]domain commands; preserve optimistic UI behavior, reconstruct completion[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]from result envelopes, and translate patch identity, dedup, exclusive [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]scopes, workspace claims, AXE slots, and agent metadata locks into [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]atomically reserved namespaced concurrency keys.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]commands, and plugin/update operations to explicit domain argv plus [/#D7D7AF]

    [#AF87FF][dim]migrate-bead-plugin-and-utility-producers[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]readonly-ace-proc-observer: replace ProcQueue ownership and ProcMirror [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]writes with an off-event-loop, read-only observer of supervisor-owned [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]proc ids, results, active counts, and logs; marshal selective/coalesced [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]updates through the UI thread, restore authoritative state after ACE [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]restart, preserve Procs-pane and optimistic completion behavior, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prove quitting or killing ACE cannot affect active commands.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Detached-option retirement and invariants[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]detach-retirement-and-enforcement[dim] · [dim][/dim]after readonly-ace-proc-observer[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]detach-retirement-and-enforcement: remove public -d/--detached from proc[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]run, proc list, and the legacy task alias because every new proc is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]supervisor-owned; keep --session only for attribution, always include [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unattributed procs alongside an explicit session filter, retain hidden [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]legacy-kind history filtering, add the one-release suppressed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]obsolete-token diagnostic, update help/completions/docs, and enforce [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]statically and in tests that proc APIs accept only durable argv and no [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]active proc is owned by the ACE pid.[/#D7D7AF]
